content.text:
the tower

The tower sleeps. Four lamps wait for your messages.
What you send is what they keep.

A lamp keeps one message.
When you send it, the lamp seals.

You can change your answer as many times as you like before you send it.

The tower wakes.

The messages you sent are kept here.

This is a second look at the pictures. The lamps stay sealed.

The keeper's night is over.

Still looking?

Stop for tonight?
The lamps you have not sent to will stay dark.
